title.narrative: ¿Strengthening resilience of key population groups and Human Rights Defenders in Liberia¿

description.narrative: The action will tackle the key problems of continuing discrimination, stigmatization and violence against LGBTIQ+ populations through an approach that will a) create the awareness to change attitudes and challenge misleading concepts and the strong influence of cultural and religious traditions that continue to influence communities in a negative way and b) provide a framework of support to the organisations and HRDs that work with the LGBTIQ+ community through protection mechanisms and services in their struggle to achieve their rights and live lives free from insecurity and discrimination.
